<!-- Post-purchase welcome page. Not in the navbar/sidebar — reached from the Lemon
     Squeezy confirmation modal + email receipt buttons (…/welcome.html?key=[license_key]).
     Two-step onboarding: (1) first install vs already-have-the-trial → reveals the right
     block (and triggers the DMG download for first installs, built from the
     jackmoebius-version variable); (2) the buyer's license key (read from the URL, client
     side) + the activation methods, each with a Copy button. -->

```{=html}
<div class="dl-page">
  <img src="assets/icon.png" alt="JackMoebius" class="dl-icon">
  <h1>Welcome to JackMoebius</h1>
  <p id="dl-greeting" class="dl-greeting">Thanks for your purchase, <span id="dl-name"></span>&nbsp;!</p>
  <div class="dl-trust">
    <span class="fa-stack hero-seal" aria-hidden="true">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-certificate fa-stack-2x"></i>
      <i class="fa-solid fa-check fa-stack-1x"></i>
    </span>
    Signed &amp; notarized by Apple
  </div>

  <!-- STEP 1 -->
  <div class="dl-step">
    <p class="dl-steptitle">1 · Is this a first install, or do you already have it?</p>
    <div class="dl-choices">
      <button type="button" class="dl-choice" id="ch-new">Installing for the first time</button>
      <button type="button" class="dl-choice" id="ch-have">I already have it (from the trial)</button>
    </div>

    <div class="dl-note dl-panel" id="panel-new" hidden>
      <div class="dl-dl">
        <a class="hero-pill hero-pill-primary dl-btn" id="download-btn" onclick="openDownloadModal(event)"
           href="https://github.com/zinc75/JackMoebius/releases/download/v{{< var jackmoebius-version >}}/JackMoebius-{{< var jackmoebius-version >}}.dmg">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-down-to-bracket"></i>
          Download JackMoebius {{< var jackmoebius-version >}}
        </a>
      </div>
      <ol class="dl-steps">
        <li>Open the downloaded <strong>.dmg</strong>.</li>
        <li>Run <strong>Install JackMoebius.pkg</strong> and follow the installer.</li>
        <li>macOS asks you to <strong>restart</strong> — the audio driver loads at the next boot.</li>
      </ol>
    </div>

    <div class="dl-note dl-panel dl-reinstall" id="panel-have" hidden>
      Great — <strong>no need to reinstall</strong>. Just activate below.
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- STEP 2 -->
  <div class="dl-step">
    <p class="dl-steptitle">2 · Activate your license</p>
    <div class="dl-note">
      <p id="dl-key-line" class="dl-keyline">Your license key:
        <code id="dl-key"></code>
        <button id="dl-key-copy" type="button" class="dl-copybtn">Copy</button>
      </p>
      <p>Unlock JackMoebius in <a href="https://zinc75.github.io/JackMate">JackMate</a>, or run:</p>
      <div class="dl-cmd">
        <code id="dl-cmd">jackmoebius license activate YOUR-KEY</code>
        <button id="dl-copy" type="button" class="dl-copybtn">Copy</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- STEP 3 -->
  <div class="dl-step">
    <p class="dl-steptitle">3 · Start using it</p>
    <div class="dl-note">
      Start a <strong>JACK</strong> server (via <a href="https://zinc75.github.io/JackMate">JackMate</a>),
      then expose your apps in JackMoebius. Enjoy!
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Wrong-platform modals — same behaviour as the site's Download button. macOS just
     downloads (this page already shows the install steps); non-Mac gets a heads-up. -->
<div id="dm-confirm-modal" class="dm-overlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="dm-confirm-title">
  <div class="dm-dialog dm-dialog-sm">
    <div class="dm-header">
      <div class="dm-header-icon icon-bg-violet"><i class="fa-brands fa-apple"></i></div>
      <div>
        <h2 id="dm-confirm-title" class="dm-title">JackMoebius is a macOS driver</h2>
        <p class="dm-intro">This installer only runs on macOS. Download anyway?</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="dm-footer">
      <button class="dm-cancel-btn" id="dm-confirm-cancel">Cancel</button>
      <button class="dm-close-btn" id="dm-confirm-ok">Download anyway</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="dm-mobile-modal" class="dm-overlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="dm-mobile-title">
  <div class="dm-dialog dm-dialog-sm">
    <div class="dm-header">
      <div class="dm-header-icon icon-bg-violet"><i class="fa-brands fa-apple"></i></div>
      <div>
        <h2 id="dm-mobile-title" class="dm-title">JackMoebius is a macOS driver</h2>
        <p class="dm-intro">It's a CoreAudio driver for the Mac — it can't run on iPhone or iPad. Come back from a Mac to download it.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="dm-footer dm-footer-end">
      <button class="dm-close-btn" id="dm-mobile-ok">Got it</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<style>
  .dl-page { max-width: 660px; margin: 3rem auto 4rem; text-align: center; }
  .dl-icon { width: 88px; height: 88px; border-radius: 20px; }
  .dl-page h1 { margin: 1rem 0 .6rem; }
  .dl-greeting { display: none; color: var(--jm-text-dim); margin: 0 0 1.1rem; font-size: 1.05rem; }
  .dl-greeting #dl-name { color: var(--jm-text); font-weight: 600; }
  .dl-trust { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; margin: 0 0 2rem;
              color: var(--jm-text-dim); font-weight: 500; }
  .dl-step { margin: 1.7rem 0; text-align: left; }
  .dl-steptitle { font-weight: 700; color: var(--jm-text); margin: 0 0 .8rem; font-size: 1.05rem; }
  .dl-choices { display: flex; gap: .7rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .dl-choice { flex: 1 1 210px; cursor: pointer; padding: .8rem 1rem; border-radius: 12px;
               border: 1px solid var(--jm-border-med); background: var(--jm-bg-card);
               color: var(--jm-text-dim); font-size: .95rem; text-align: center; transition: all .12s; }
  .dl-choice:hover { color: var(--jm-text); border-color: var(--jm-border-hi); }
  .dl-choice.active { color: var(--jm-text); border-color: #38bdf8; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #38bdf8; }
  .dl-panel { margin-top: 1rem; }
  .dl-dl { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .dl-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; }
  .dl-lead { color: var(--jm-text-dim); margin: .8rem 0 0; font-size: .9rem; }
  .dl-steps { margin: 1rem 0 0; padding-left: 1.4rem; line-height: 1.85; }
  .dl-note { color: var(--jm-text-dim); background: var(--jm-bg-card); text-align: left;
             border: 1px solid var(--jm-border-med); border-radius: 14px; padding: 1rem 1.2rem; }
  .dl-note p { margin: 0 0 .6rem; }
  .dl-note p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .dl-reinstall { border-left: 3px solid #38bdf8; }
  .dl-keyline { display: none; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .dl-keyline code { color: var(--jm-text); background: rgba(0,0,0,.25);
                     padding: .35rem .55rem; border-radius: 8px; }
  .dl-cmd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .dl-cmd code { flex: 1 1 auto; background: rgba(0,0,0,.25); padding: .45rem .65rem;
                 border-radius: 8px; word-break: break-all; }
  .dl-copybtn { flex: none; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--jm-border-med);
                background: transparent; color: var(--jm-text-dim); border-radius: 8px;
                padding: .35rem .75rem; font-size: .82rem; }
  .dl-copybtn:hover { color: var(--jm-text); border-color: var(--jm-border-hi); }
</style>

<script>
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    // Step 1: reveal the matching block. The Download button handles the download
    // itself, with the same platform-aware modal as the site's index (openDownloadModal).
    var chNew = document.getElementById('ch-new'), chHave = document.getElementById('ch-have');
    var panelNew = document.getElementById('panel-new'), panelHave = document.getElementById('panel-have');
    function choose(isNew) {
      panelNew.hidden = !isNew; panelHave.hidden = isNew;
      chNew.classList.toggle('active', isNew);
      chHave.classList.toggle('active', !isNew);
    }
    chNew.addEventListener('click', function () { choose(true); });
    chHave.addEventListener('click', function () { choose(false); });

    // Step 2: license key from the URL (?key= — Lemon Squeezy's form — or a #fragment).
    // textContent keeps it XSS-safe.
    function readKey() {
      var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('key');
      if (q && /^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,}$/.test(q)) return q;
      var raw = decodeURIComponent((location.hash || '').replace(/^#(?:key=)?/, '')).trim();
      return /^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,}$/.test(raw) ? raw : null;
    }
    var key = readKey();
    if (key) {
      document.getElementById('dl-key').textContent = key;
      document.getElementById('dl-key-line').style.display = 'flex';
      document.getElementById('dl-cmd').textContent = 'jackmoebius license activate ' + key;
    }

    // Optional: greet the buyer by name (Lemon Squeezy's [name] variable). textContent-safe.
    var nm = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('name');
    if (nm && (nm = nm.trim()) && nm.length <= 60) {
      document.getElementById('dl-name').textContent = nm;
      document.getElementById('dl-greeting').style.display = 'block';
    }

    function wireCopy(btnId, srcId) {
      var btn = document.getElementById(btnId), src = document.getElementById(srcId);
      if (!btn || !src) return;
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (navigator.clipboard) navigator.clipboard.writeText(src.textContent);
        var t = btn.textContent; btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
        setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = t; }, 1500);
      });
    }
    wireCopy('dl-key-copy', 'dl-key');
    wireCopy('dl-copy', 'dl-cmd');
  });
</script>
```
